scientific_integrity: A proof for all m>=3 uses Zhong’s published disjoint-matchable-pair gamma identity, a unique-matching lemma in proper subforests of the cycle, a cycle transfer matrix, and an exact Chebyshev root count. All finite checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Only crown preorder-polytope support enumerators, not all preorders or crown order-polytope Ehrhart h-star polynomials. The general gamma identity, cyclic matching count and Chebyshev identities are prior ingredients. Historical priority provisional; a relevant detailed contemporary release was available, but its underlying paper was not independently read. Independent audit not performed.
title: Crown-preorder support enumerators have simple negative roots in every even order
